notes.title: New Update! Bugfixes and Settings...
notes.content:
Ca-Caw! Just pushed a brand new update to version 1.0.21!

Something you might want to check out is a new Gameplay Setting called "Wall Bounce" 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/e13ab43895f5f53b14e68e5ef8e55dd503056bbb.jpg

This lets you disable bouncing off of walls and making the squeaky sound.  Personally, I love the way it works by default, but thought it might make flying around easier for some folks based on the feedback we got. Here's what it looks like side by side On and Off:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/8325b7406b798481126ec1b3a4f120f957ab1b62.gif

 Let us know what you think.

Here's the full changelog since last patch notes:

v1.0.21
- Added Wall Bounce setting and slightly re-scaled things
- Updated default joystick mappings for Playstation 4 controllers
- Added localization support for Control Mapper
- Crow Customizer: adjusted text position to prevent button overlap
- Crow Customizer will now refresh more (fixes potential bug where it might not show unlocked decors)
- Slight text changes and clarifications in dialogues
- Quaint Town: added extra briefcase guy for safety and made the task / achievement more forgiving
- Egypt: hid confusing keyhole on sphinx
- Egypt: changed number of diamonds needed to be stolen to 4 
- Egypt: added collider under diamond boat to prevent diamonds getting lost under it
- Egypt: added a hint about lantern making tornadoes go away
- Ponyhawk now mention races are optional
- Edgar: added extra glow around first window to hint players what to do a bit more
- Camp: added extra flashlight before the Hedgehog House as backup
- Camp: fixed first fireplace potentially not showing fire
- Fixed potential softlock on start of Fantasy and CraftWorld when holding cancel button during loading screen
- Moon: fixed crystal detector not showing up when first crystal quest completed and level restarted
- Moon: ship core detection box increased size to prevent losing core when clipping into the stand

notes.title: Control ReMapping + Other Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey all, we just added support to remap controls :D

Just press F1 on Main Menu to bring it up

(it's still a wee bit WIP and rudimentary, and the in-game prompts will not be replaced just YET, but we wanted to get the feature out and usable before the weekend!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/c657c43a5884b79dcdcc6a942ce9a2cd84fbed5f.jpg

We also got a bunch of new fixes in v 1.0.14


 Fixed an issue with text disappearing on SteamDeck
 Fixed a number of typos and clarified some texts
 Hat unlocking spheres: made them easier to trigger
 Overworld: adjusted first Gramma Crow conversation trigger so it does not occur when player is in water
 Quaint Town: add glint to fish to make them harder to miss
 Quaint Town: coins remove glint when when picked (fixes air-sparkling issue)
 Quaint Town: fixed cat quest breaking if you completed before talking to mice
 Quaint Town: Added extra collider to prevent accidentally dropping leafblower between starter buildings
 Quaint Town: Added extra backup leafblower 
 Camp: made the first campfire count towards the quest goal
 Camp: moved the gate campfire around since players kept missing it
 Camp: notes no longer show on Sandbox mode


Happy weekend, Ca-Caw!

notes.title: Patch Notes (August 21, 2024)
notes.content:
We're listing to all the feedback and updating the game as we speak! Here's a list of changes in latest patch:


Features

 Added an "Un-Stuck Crowy" button to Pause Menu on off chance you get stuck (it teleports you to where you started the level)


Tweaks

 Toned down volume of the Level Completed / Hat Obtained music
 Decreased number of baby squirrels needed to bing back to mom and made them easier to see
 Craftworld: made drying hoomans quest more forgiving
 Camp: Adjusted position of some campfires on
 Made cat water collider bigger on Quaint Town to make it easier to soak
 Added "Controller Recommended" prompt at start


Bugfixes

 Fixed Fantasy level end cutsene potentially breaking if you Alt-Tab
 Fixed Cloudy falling thru the floor when dropped when standing on the ground
 Fixed some text typos and adjusted text positions for better readability
 Egypt: made gems harder to lose and adjusted some colliders


NEXT UP: We're working on adding some more control settings and rebindable keys, so stay tuned!

Update: the Key Binding is IN! Still bit rudimentary and we're working on improving that, but it's in there if you want to use it early :D

notes.title: Thank You for Playing and Your Feedback! Plus some updates!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

This is Jakub, the team lead! Hope you are enjoying "Just Crow Things", we put over two years of effort into it by now. I have been going through some review and forums posts, and really enjoying reading everyone's impressions, good or bad 😄

We already made a few updates to the game based on the feedback we got, and squashed a few bugs that might soft-lock you from completing some quests. Thank you to everyone reporting on our Forums  and Discord!

We're a small team who is entirely self-funded and self-published, so unfortunately some things just slipped through our cracks (despite a few testing rounds). So we're still keeping eye on things, and taking ALL your feedback into consideration!

Thank you for playing, thank you for leaving us Steam reviews, as well as sharing and tweeting your cute birbs at us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/9bc03ea6a29a09f757bba8a8572e909995dd4867.jpg

Ca-Caw!!!

------------

Here's the  full change log:


 Fixed Fantasy level end cutsene potentially breaking if you Alt-Tab
  Fixed Cloudy falling thru the floor when dropped when standing on the ground
  Fixed some text typos and adjusted text positions for better readability 
 Fixed issues on Tutorial where "Meet Animal friends" quest could be soft locked if completing quests and restarting the level
 Fixed an issue on Camp where Hedgehog quest could get soft-locked 
 Adjusted music volume on some levels for better experience
 Defaulted music volume to 70% now
 Fixed some text typos
 Added alternate keyboard bindings and prompts
 Fixed a bug with Crow Customizer sometimes not responding to buttons properly after beating the game
 Fixed a bug with potentially losing Cloudy on the Beach level
 Fixed a bug with fish potentially disappearing on the first Quaint Town level
 Fixed "Decor Unlocked" screen not scaling properly on wide screen monitors
